images.caption: Figure 1:A coding agent trains an optical neural network in situ, from measurements alone.a, Conventional deployment of optical neural networks. Phase masks trained in silico on an ideal model (angular-spectrum method, ASM) lose accuracy on the optical experiment, where gradients are not directly accessible.b, The two earlier routes to in situ training, and optics as code, in which a large language model writes code whose output, the phase masksθ\thetaand the probes, is displayed on the experiment.f^\hat{f}, calibrated model.LL, loss.rr, reward.c, Photograph and schematic of the experiment. SLM, spatial light modulator.d, The coding agent, a large language model, reads camera images, scores and its notes, and writes hypotheses, code, phase masks and notes of its findings. It reaches the experiment only through the harness, the software that executes its requests and returns the measurements. The test set is sealed.e, Best validation accuracy versus measurements on the experiment for the agent with the notes of an earlier session (circles, validations) and without, and for proximal policy optimization (PPO) and policy gradient (PG). Diamond, backpropagation through a calibrated model, whose calibration alone used 67,000 camera images (arrow, beyond the axis). Dotted, start. Right,φ2\varphi_{2}(top) and camera data (bottom) at numbered reasoning steps. 1, probes verifying the earlier notes. 2, the class displaces the focused spots (difference of two classes). 3, one spot per block of phase maskφ2\varphi_{2}. 4, the agent’s first own design from these spots.

Figure 2:The agent trains an optical classifier on the experiment to the accuracy of backpropagation.a, Schematic of the experiment, and the two phase masks at the start, at the agent’s first own design and at the end of the best agent run, given the notes of an earlier session, with the measurements spent.b, Test accuracy on the 3,147 test digits at the end of the budget, for the best run of each method. Filled circle, agent with the notes of an earlier session. Open circle, agent without notes. Squares, PPO and policy gradient. Dashed, phase masks trained by backpropagation through a calibrated model of the device and scored on the experiment (96.3%). Dotted, start.c, Camera images averaged over the practice digits of each class, at the three stages, with the three detectors.d, Fraction of the detected energy on each detector, per digit class.e, Confusion matrix, in per cent of the digits of each class. Start and final phase masks indande, 3,147 test digits. First design, 128 practice digits.

Figure 3:The agent trains an optical encoder that learns a compact representation of images.The optics compress each Fashion-MNIST image into 16 detector signals, which play the role of the latent space of an autoencoder, and a digital decoder reconstructs the image from them.a, Phase masksφ1\varphi_{1}andφ2\varphi_{2}with random values, after an agent run without notes and after the agent run that received the notes and code of an earlier session, with the mean test peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR).b, Ground-truth test images (top) and their reconstructions by the digital decoder for the phase masks ofa(arrows), with the PSNR of each reconstruction. The five images are spread evenly over the 50 test images that the agent run with notes improved most.c, Progress during training of the two agent runs ofaand of PPO, the gradient-free baseline without a language model. Lines, gain in validation PSNR over the random start. Markers, single validations. The run with notes starts high because the agent rebuilt the earlier design before its first measurement.d, Gain in test PSNR over the random start at the end of the budget, one run per row, for three language models (Claude Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5) and for PPO. Filled circles, runs with the notes and code of an earlier session. Open circles, runs with general lessons only. Square, PPO. Dashed, phase masks trained by backpropagation through a calibrated model.

Figure 4:The agent understands the experiment through its own measurements and designs the optics from this understanding.a, Probes chosen and written by the agent on the input and the two phase masks (top), and their camera images (bottom). Each probe occupies one plane, with the others flat. A disk locates each plane on the camera, and a phase step tests interference across each phase mask.b, Displacement of the intensity centroid on the camera for the same tilt (20 phase cycles) on each plane. Dots,xxandyytilts.c, Fringe contrast for the same phase step on each phase mask. Dotted, flat.d, Both phase masks at the start and after the two routes of the runs, fine-tuning or a new design. The two new designs come from separate runs. The Fourier router (run from the task text alone) splitsφ1\varphi_{1}into four lens sections. The spot router (run with earlier notes) focuses 49 blocks ofφ2\varphi_{2}onto the detectors. Numbers, test accuracy.e, Test accuracy on the calibrated model with reduced information for the agent, and with earlier notes (filled circle). Square, PPO. Added rules did not help (Methods).f, Reasoning traces of the run from the task text alone, in seven steps from its first probe to the tuned Fourier router. Each step gives the hypothesis, the probe (blue) or design (red) that tested it, the finding, what the agent learned and the validation accuracy that followed. Top, measurements used (Methods).
